title: COVE: A Task-Adaptive, Code-Based Ensemble for Proactive Verification of LLM Outputs
title_zh: COVE：基于代码的任务自适应集成方法，用于主动验证LLM输出

paragraphs.en: COVE用纯Python代码技术在生成前后主动验证LLM输出，大幅提升准确率并降低成本。 Large Language Models (LLMs) are now embedded in enterprise workflows, yet their outputs remain prone to hallucinations: plausible-sounding but factually incorrect or malformed content. Most verification approaches are reactive, detecting errors only after generation and often spending additional expensive LLM calls to do so. We present COVE, a task-adaptive, code-based ensemble that takes the opposite stance: it prevents errors before generation and validates structure and consistency afterwards using six deterministic, pure-Python innovations that add no extra LLM calls. On an internal evaluation spanning 11 text datasets (1,020 examples) and 4 image datasets (200 examples), COVE lifts text accuracy from a 45.2% unverified baseline to 82.1% (an 81.7% relative improvement), improves image accuracy by 69.5%, and reduces token usage by 48 to 96% (simulated cost model), at a measured verification overhead of 0.26 ms per output (excluding the LLM call). This article describes the engineering design of each innovation (with pseudocode and the exact parameters we use), the measured impact, an ablation of every component, and the practical lessons learned from deploying code-based verification in enterprise pipelines.
paragraphs.zh: COVE用纯Python代码技术在生成前后主动验证LLM输出，大幅提升准确率并降低成本。大语言模型（LLM）如今已嵌入企业工作流，但其输出仍容易出现幻觉：看似合理却事实错误或格式有误的内容。 大多数验证方法是被动式的，只在生成之后才检测错误，而且往往要花费额外的昂贵LLM调用。 我们提出COVE，一种任务自适应的基于代码的集成方法，它持相反立场：在生成之前预防错误，并在生成之后使用六项确定性的纯Python创新技术来验证结构与一致性，且不增加任何额外的LLM调用。 在涵盖11个文本数据集（1,020个样例）和4个图像数据集（200个样例）的内部评估中，COVE将文本准确率从45.2%的未验证基线提升至82.1%（相对提升81.7%），将图像准确率提升69.5%，并将token使用量降低48%至96%（模拟成本模型），实测验证开销为每个输出0.26毫秒（不含LLM调用）。 本文描述每项创新技术的工程设计（附伪代码与我们使用的确切参数）、实测影响、对每个组件的消融实验，以及在企业流水线中部署基于代码的验证所获得的实践经验。
